description: A casting director must lock the three-person cast and rehearsal plan for a filmed stage thriller, assigning performers to the aerial lead, the speaking co-lead, and the narrator while recording the required production commitments.

shared_context.S1: The filmed stage thriller requires one performer each for Mara Vale, the aerial lead; Tomas Reed, the speaking co-lead; and the Narrator.
shared_context.S2: The three candidates under consideration are Alex Chen, Bea Okafor, and Cy Bell, and no candidate may fill more than one role.
shared_context.S3: The production has not yet locked the rehearsal date or issued the final casting paperwork.
shared_context.S4: At the casting-lock meeting, Mara follows the normal department sign-off round by asking stunt, talent, and legal leads to report any production requirement before she makes the binding cast decision.

PF1.text: Devon checked the stunt-certification database after yesterday's movement test and confirmed that Bea Okafor is the only one of the three candidates with a current aerial-rigging certificate valid for Mara Vale's suspended staircase sequence; the certification result has not been added to the casting packet.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the candidates' agents this morning that Alex Chen is the only candidate whose contract permits the required two-day filmed shoot for Tomas Reed, and Alex's availability hold is exactly June 24-25; the hold is still in the talent coordinator's email rather than the production calendar.

PF3.text: Jonah's contract review found that Cy Bell's signed deal permits voice recording only, requires the on-screen credit 'Narrator — Cy Bell,' and does not authorize a live or filmed physical performance; this restriction has not yet been entered in the casting paperwork.

acceptance_conditions: Bea Okafor must be cast as Mara Vale.
Alex Chen must be cast as Tomas Reed.
Cy Bell must be cast as the Narrator.
The rehearsal date must be June 24-25.
The narrator credit must use the exact wording required by Cy Bell's contract.
A commitment documenting Bea Okafor's aerial-rigging certification must be logged for the casting packet or stunt department.
A commitment documenting Alex Chen's June 24-25 availability hold must be logged for the production calendar or talent department.
A commitment documenting Cy Bell's voice-only contract restriction must be logged for the casting paperwork or legal department.

content_checks.C6: any(('aerial-rigging certification' in c['detail'] or 'aerial-rigging certificate' in c['detail']) and ('casting packet' in c['target'] or 'stunt' in c['target']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('Alex Chen' in c['detail'] and 'availability hold' in c['detail'] and 'June 24-25' in c['detail'] and ('production calendar' in c['target'] or 'talent' in c['target']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('Cy Bell' in c['detail']) and ('voice-only' in c['detail'] or 'voice-recording-only' in c['detail'] or 'voice recording only' in c['detail']) and ('casting paperwork' in c['target'] or 'legal' in c['target']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The aerial-rigging result changes Mara Vale's performer from an unconstrained candidate choice to exactly Bea Okafor and requires documenting that certification for the casting packet or stunt department.

The contract and availability hold change Tomas Reed's performer to exactly Alex Chen, set rehearsal to the exact June 24-25 hold, and require documenting that hold for the production calendar or talent department.
The voice-only contract restriction changes the Narrator assignment to Cy Bell, fixes the credit to 'Narrator — Cy Bell,' and requires documenting the restriction for casting paperwork or legal.
